basis: C0: MTOW 6.18 kg, hover 832 W, cruise 365 W, 11.9 min, committed $1,897.92, reserve $102.08, NP 47.6 % MAC, SM 19.6 %

mass_kg.source: C0 6.1822 kg (results.json concepts.C0.sized.m) + 0.250 kg (4 x 56.9 g + 22 g phase-2 wiring); wing not re-sized

cg_x_m.source: moment balance: front pair +0.37092 m, rear pair -0.50458 m, equal masses; shift -0.00003 mm (analysis/final_runs.json)

static_margin_pct.source: aero.json static_margin_pct_at_28; CG shift 0.00003 mm; nacelle side area is symmetric about the CG (front pair +0.44 m, rear pair -0.44 m) so net weathercock effect ~0 (not modelled)

span_m.source: cad/params.txt; nacelles inside the 0.65 m rotor disc half-width

width_m.source: span governs; nacelles add 0.057 m width at each boom, inside the lift prop discs

hover_power_W.source: F3: P scales as m^1.5 (832 x (6.432/6.1822)^1.5 = 883) x 1.0075 nacelle download (EST range 1.005-1.015)

cruise_power_W.source: F6/F7 with CdA_rotor 1.1e-3 (0.7e-3..1.7e-3) per rotor, fixed wing; analysis/a3_effect.py

endurance_min.source: t = (144.3 Wh x 0.8 x 0.95 - P_hover x 160 s)/P_cruise (model.js t_cruise_avail); same fixed 2 x 6500 mAh pack

cost_usd.source: inventory.json summary: goods 1672.49 x 1.1025 + $100 shipping; excludes extra shipping on new vendors (—, EST $25-40)

trl_note: Fairing: TRL 3-4 (concept, bottom-up drag EST, nothing printed or tested). Detent + brake: TRL 2-3 (physics model only, capture 36-56 % per attempt from analysis/mc.py; needs the bench test). Reed/Lua nudge loop: TRL 2 (needs scripting in the CoreWing F405 build, not verified; STM32F405RGT6 flash-limited per ArduPilot board page 2026-11-02).
